metadata.title: Implement True Cost of Debt Card

story.iWant: to see the true cost of my debt
story.soThat: I understand how much money is going to interest alone

task.title: Create TrueCostCard types
task.subtask: Create src/types/true-cost.ts
Define TrueCostMetrics interface: monthlyInterest, annualInterest, interestToIncomeRatio, isHighBurden
Export from src/types/index.ts

task.title: Create interest calculation utilities
task.subtask: Create src/lib/calculations/interest.ts (or extend if exists)
Implement calculateMonthlyInterest(account: DebtAccount): Big - Standard loans: (balance × rate) / 12
Implement calculateFlexiMonthlyInterest for daily compounding: (balance × rate) / 365 × 30
Implement calculateTotalMonthlyInterest(accounts: DebtAccount[], flexi: FlexiFacility | null): Big
Use big.js for all calculations per ADR-003
Handle edge cases: zero balance, zero rate

task.title: Create useTrueCost hook
task.subtask: Create src/hooks/useTrueCost.ts
Import useAccounts, useFlexiFacility, useFinancialSnapshot from existing hooks
Calculate monthlyInterest: sum of all account interest charges
Calculate annualInterest: monthlyInterest × 12
Calculate interestToIncomeRatio: (monthlyInterest / monthlyIncome) × 100
Calculate isHighBurden: ratio > 20
Handle edge cases: no accounts (return zero), no income (ratio = 0)
Return { trueCost: TrueCostMetrics, isLoading, error }

Display monthly interest charges in red (text-red-500)
Display annual interest projection in red (text-red-500)
Display interest-to-income ratio with percentage formatting
Conditionally show "High debt burden" warning if ratio > 20%
Add warning icon (lucide-react AlertTriangle) next to warning message
Handle loading state with skeleton
Handle empty data state (no accounts)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I have debt accounts entered, when I view the Dashboard, then I see a "True Cost of Debt" card
Card displays Monthly Interest Charges: total interest across all accounts in ZAR format (R X,XXX.XX)
Card displays Annual Interest Projection: Monthly Interest × 12 in ZAR format
Card displays Interest-to-Income Ratio: (Monthly Interest / Monthly Income) × 100 as percentage
Interest values display in red (honest truth-telling per UX spec)
If Interest-to-Income Ratio > 20%, card shows warning message "High debt burden"
Card uses teal header (#0d9488) per UX spec
Card handles edge cases: no accounts, no income (division by zero), flexi vs standard interest calculation

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR41: System calculates and displays true cost of debt: total monthly interest charges across all accounts (ZAR), annual interest cost projection, percentage of income going to interest only (not principal)

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR9: System calculates daily interest for flexi facility accounts using accurate daily compounding formula. FR10: System calculates monthly interest for standard loan accounts using standard amortization formulas.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Decision: Use big.js for all monetary calculations. Consequences: Cent-level accuracy guaranteed, slightly more verbose code, string storage for precision preservation, 6KB bundle size impact.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Decision: Use Zustand for UI state, Dexie for persistent data. No Zustand needed for this story - data flows from Dexie via existing hooks → useTrueCost (new) → React components.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: lib/calculations/ folder contains FR9-23 Calculation Engine: types.ts, engine.ts, interest.ts (FR9-11: Interest formulas), projections.ts, and strategies/ subfolder.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Semantic Colors: Error/Debt: red-500 (#ef4444) - High debt cost, off-track, critical issues. Primary: teal-600 (#0d9488) - Main brand color, buttons, headers, primary actions.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: HealthCard - Displays one of "Three Critical Numbers" with color-coded status. Card structure uses shadcn/ui Card component with teal header.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown

node.purpose: Arbitrary precision decimal arithmetic for financial calculations
Icons including AlertTriangle for warning message

constraints.constraint: All monetary calculations MUST use big.js for precision - no native JavaScript arithmetic for financial values
Store monetary values as strings (e.g., "958.33") for big.js compatibility
Flexi facility monthly interest: (balance × rate) / 365 × 30 (daily compounding approximation)
Data flow: Dexie DB → useLiveQuery hooks → useTrueCost hook → TrueCostCard component
Interest values MUST display in red (text-red-500) for honest truth-telling
Follow established patterns from IncomeExpenseCard and useIncomeExpense hook
Bundle size advisory: Currently at 635KB, approaching 500KB warning threshold

interface.name: TrueCostMetrics
interface.signature: interface TrueCostMetrics { monthlyInterest: string; annualInterest: string; interestToIncomeRatio: string; isHighBurden: boolean; }

interface.name: useTrueCost
interface.signature: function useTrueCost(): { trueCost: TrueCostMetrics | null; isLoading: boolean; error: string | null; }

interface.name: calculateMonthlyInterest
interface.signature: function calculateMonthlyInterest(balance: string, annualRate: string, interestType: InterestType): Big

interface.name: calculateTotalMonthlyInterest
interface.signature: function calculateTotalMonthlyInterest(accounts: DebtAccount[], flexiFacility: FlexiFacility | null): Big

interface.name: useFinancialSnapshot
interface.signature: function useFinancialSnapshot(): { snapshot: FinancialSnapshot; isLoading: boolean; isHealthy: boolean; }

tests.standards: Testing follows Vitest + React Testing Library patterns. Tests are organized in tests/ directory mirroring src/ structure. Hook tests use renderHook from @testing-library/react with fake-indexeddb for database mocking. Component tests render with @testing-library/react and assert on DOM output. All database tables are cleared in beforeEach. Tests should verify big.js precision and edge cases.
